desc: Correct the non-cycle tree DP traversal order to compute children before parents.
Detect all cycle vertices/components and exclude cycle-to-cycle edges when accumulating attached-tree contributions.
Compute each cycle component’s contribution by summing over the common cycle value.
Multiply independent component contributions modulo \(998244353\), including self-loops and components without attached trees.
Verify all samples and maintain \(O(NM)\) time with safe memory usage.
